lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible spatial arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill region, organized into approximately three horizontal rows where the central row contains the largest and most distinct maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the posterior flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher-intensity pixels on the superior aspect and distinct shadowing on the inferior aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense population of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more randomly distributed than the clusters found on the primary flank.
